doc: Large coordinates, |x| from 1e4 to 1e7 (float32 resolution 1e-3 to 1): the fractional part x - floor(x) is exact in float32 but coarse, and the int64 cast & 255 must see the whole integer part. Measured spread against float64: 4.8e-7. Same tolerance as perlin3.f32.random. The permutation input plan<i>.perm is the draw as recorded (256 entries for Perlin3, 1024 for Worley3); the kernel indexes it DOUBLED, concat(perm, perm) (512 or 2048 entries, so p[i + 256] = p[i]): a port that indexes the stored array directly runs off its end (see the .table cases).
